title: Show the literal recurrence misses the same required pair
body:
## Summary
- The fixed-cover correction has 4,992 required pairs. The eight-layer literal quotient recurrence reaches 4,991 of them.
- The only missing pair is target 71 from source 102. Its matrix entry is `-4`, so the coefficient is `-1/2`.
- At every dimension the literal relation equals the interval relation and the archived layer digest. No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The backward cone is not rebuilt.
